_description: Single source of truth for author identity + cluster routing on mybcat.com. Consumed by /src/pages/author/*.astro for E-A-T schema rendering AND by the blog_writer pipeline (route_author.py) for byline assignment.

ankit-patel.name: Ankit Patel
ankit-patel.title: Founder & CEO, My Business Care Team
ankit-patel.bio: Ankit Patel is the founder and CEO of My Business Care Team (MyBCAT) and co-founder of Classic Vision Care. Healthcare operations expert with background at Dell and Cleveland Clinic. Lean Six Sigma certified. He writes about enterprise healthcare operations, multi-location DSO/PE strategy, EBITDA-driven scheduling and intake operations, financial mechanics of practice scaling, and the playbook for building managed back-office services for healthcare groups. Author of 'Optometry Redefined: Master Resourcing and Performance' and host of the Optometrists Building Empires podcast.
ankit-patel.image_alt: Ankit Patel - Founder & CEO of MyBCAT

dr-mital-patel.name: Dr. Mital Patel, OD
dr-mital-patel.title: Doctor of Optometry, Clinical Advisor — MyBCAT
dr-mital-patel.bio: Dr. Mital Patel, OD is the clinical advisor for MyBCAT and co-founder of Classic Vision Care. Practicing optometrist for 25+ years specializing in dry eye, specialty contact lenses, and comprehensive eye care. Doctor of Optometry from Southern College of Optometry. Certified in IPL, radio-frequency, and BlephEx treatments. She reviews MyBCAT content where the clinical perspective is essential — patient experience inside an exam, what front-desk handoffs feel like to patients, and how operational decisions land in the chair.
dr-mital-patel.image_alt: Dr. Mital Patel, OD - Clinical Advisor at MyBCAT
knows_about: Patient Experience in Specialty Eye Care

mybcat-editorial.name: MyBCAT Editorial Team
mybcat-editorial.title: MyBCAT Editorial Team
mybcat-editorial.bio: The MyBCAT Editorial Team produces fact-based, methodology-disclosed reports drawn from anonymized aggregate data across 30+ optometry, dental, and veterinary practices we manage. Published under this team byline when content is data-driven (industry benchmarks, KPI roundups, methodology-grounded research) rather than authored from a single individual's first-person experience. Reviewed by Ankit Patel (operations) and Dr. Mital Patel (clinical) before publication.
